subject: CIW kickoff — robust training under label noise as a shared component
body:
Hi Jelena,

Kicking off the CIW effort. Our Constrained Instance and Class reWeighting work formulates label-noise handling as constrained optimization problems with simple closed-form updates for instance and class weights, solved per mini-batch — no need to store weights over the full dataset. That last property is why it can be a drop-in component rather than a research artifact.

Demand is real: three teams flagged noisy-label pain in Q2 planning (weak supervision, crowdsourced labels, scraped data). Goal: a supported library + recommended recipes, validated on the standard CIFAR-10 noise benchmarks and two internal datasets.

Milestones (Apr 13 – Jul 20): library extraction by mid-May; benchmark validation June; big validation sweep early July; docs + internal release by Jul 20.

Jelena — staffing and the compute ask for the July sweep are the open items.

Ximena
